Welcome Stintino was born as a tool for a complete and safe experience within the Municipality of Stintino. 
Designed both for tourists and for the locals, it is available in both Italian and English. 
With a clean and intuitive interface, this App offers immediate performance and it is super easy to use. 
Welcome Stintino provides the user with information and restaurants’ menus thanks to QR Codes. The codes are read through the mobile phone camera:

• if it’s a restaurant’s QR, it’ll be displayed restaurant information and the list of available menus
• if it’s a menu’s QR, the user is shown the list of available dishes, prices and allergens.

Welcome Stintino is available also in offline mode, offering the possibility to view the list of previously scanned QRs. 
This app is an important tool not only for tourists and locals, who will be connected with the surrounding restaurants, but also for owners, who will have the opportunity to always be just a click away with their clients. 
Welcome Stintino identifies the language of the smartphone and will automatically adapt to "Italian" or "English".
